svg.aria-label: JourneyGuard checks the Aegean Coffee Co. shop like a customer: homepage, product, add to cart, checkout, payment. The first run passes. On the second run checkout fails, payment is not reached, and an alert explains the likely cause (PHP/WordPress fatal error) and goes out to Telegram, Email and Slack.
